resolved.title: 特殊的字符串(转义字符串)
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Special Characters[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

There are a number of special characters that can be used in strings.
[b]\n[/b] represents a new line:[code format="py" codeId="2599"]print('One [b]\n[/b]Two [b]\n[/b]Three') [/code]
Similarly, [b]\t[/b] represents a tab.

If you want to include a single quote in a single-quoted string (or a double quote in a double-quoted string), you need to escape it using a [b]backslash[/b]:
[code format="py" codeId="2850"]print('Brian[b]\'[/b]s mother: He[b]\'[/b]s not an angel. He[b]\'[/b]s a very naughty boy!')[/code]
[note]The backslash is also called the escape character.[/note]
